correctness.rationale: Unitary DFT in each modulation index k separates matrix cyclic lags d. The row for slope s has frequency 2ds, so slopes are orthogonal except when congruent modulo m_d=n/gcd(n,2d); each occupied residue class contributes squared singular value a_{m_d}(c). Since 2d ranges over subgroup of order h=n/gcd(n,2) with kernel size g, m_d=m appears gφ(m) times; rank and full kernel follow. Occupancy ≤min(r,m) saturates simultaneously for consecutive slopes. Even-n saturation and optimizer count reduce to choosing doubled antipodal pairs. Coordinate projectors supply n−1 additional diagonal dimensions and full Hermitian injectivity exactly for n odd prime. Independent complex Hermitian SVD checks on 26 small n, mask families match; no finite test substitutes for character orthogonality.
